# uptimeify_report (Resource)

A scheduled fleet report of the organization (mail, optionally with PDF). Unset optional attributes take the server default on create and keep their value afterwards. Import with the report id (UUID).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeify_report" "weekly" {
  name             = "Weekly fleet report"
  frequency        = "weekly"
  weekday          = 1
  send_hour        = 7
  format           = "email_pdf"
  recipient_emails = ["ops@example.com"]

  # The status pages section is on by default; leave it out of this report.
  include_status_pages = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `day_of_month` (Number) 1-28. Required for monthly reports.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Default `true`.
- `format` (String) `email` or `email_pdf` (default).
- `frequency` (String) `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly` (default). Weekly needs `weekday`, monthly needs `day_of_month`.
- `group_by_customer` (Boolean) Group by customer. Default `false`.
- `include_status_pages` (Boolean) Append the status pages section (published state, customer, components, incidents, maintenance, subscribers). Scope `customers` lists those customers' pages, scope `tags` the pages showing a monitor with one of the tags. Default `true`.
- `inclusion_mode` (String) `all` (default), `problems` or `threshold`.
- `monitor_types` (List of String) Monitor types in the report (default: all ten).
- `problem_signals` (Attributes) What counts as a problem for `inclusion_mode = "problems"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--problem_signals))
- `recipient_emails` (List of String)
- `recipient_user_ids` (List of String) Logins of the organization (`uptimeify_user.id`).
- `scope_customer_ids` (List of Number) Customers for `scope_mode = "customers"`.
- `scope_mode` (String) `all` (default), `customers` or `tags`.
- `scope_tag_ids` (List of Number) Tags for `scope_mode = "tags"`.
- `sections` (Attributes) Report sections (default: all on except `group_by_customer`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))
- `sections_by_type` (Map of Map of Boolean) Per monitor type section switches, e.g. `{ website = { sslExpiry = false } }` (server-side key names).
- `send_hour` (Number) Hour of day 0-23 in `timezone`. Default 2.
- `send_when_empty` (Boolean) Send even when nothing qualifies. Default `false`.
- `threshold_response_gt` (Number) Response time in ms for `inclusion_mode = "threshold"`.
- `threshold_uptime_lt` (Number) Uptime percentage for `inclusion_mode = "threshold"`.
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone. Default `Europe/Berlin`.
- `weekday` (Number) 0-6, 0 = Sunday. Required for weekly reports.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Report id (UUID).

### Nested Schema for `problem_signals`

Required:

- `incident` (Boolean)
- `response_breach` (Boolean)

Optional:

- `downtime_minutes` (Number)
- `ssl_days_lt` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--sections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sections`

Required:

- `fleet_summary` (Boolean)
- `group_by_customer` (Boolean)
- `incident_log` (Boolean)
- `per_site_table` (Boolean)
- `ssl_expiry` (Boolean)
- `worst_performers` (Boolean)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Report id (UUID)
terraform import uptimeify_report.weekly 0b5f7a3e-1c2d-4e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b
```
